description: Tutorial lesson T4 (Dakka Time), mouse player path: boot from the tutorial_t4_shoot fixture -> select the Boyz as shooter by clicking their token on the board (weapons auto-assign to the only visible target) -> Confirm (3 weapons) -> assert the step-4 card explains the hit/wound/save sequence and points at the ▲▼ re-order arrows, then actually click ▼ on the first queue row and prove the firing order swapped -> Fast Roll All in the resolution dock -> Done on each defender save results card (tolerant: pressed only while visible) -> Complete Shooting -> end the phase with the big phase button -> lesson summary -> back to menu.

steps.comment: a Boyz model - board-token path selects the unit as shooter
auto-assign count is timing-dependent (2 or 3 weapons) so the label text is not stable - use the named node
step 4 explains the hit/wound/save sequence AND points at the ▲▼ re-order arrows
every queue row carries ▲▼ on its right-hand side; stash the firing order to diff after the click
mouse path: ▼ on the first row pushes that weapon one slot later in the firing order
exactly the first two weapons swapped
defender save results card 1 - press Done only while visible
defender save results card 2 (tolerant no-op when absent)
defender save results card 3 (tolerant no-op when absent)
press Complete Shooting when the dock offers it; else clear any straggler Done card
second chance Complete Shooting after a late Done card
the phase summary is an embedded modal AcceptDialog mounted on /root (Main.gd:11318) - confirm via emit
